title: Glowing alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a3d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e2551f'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- bells -->
  <circle cx='27' cy='30' r='11' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='30' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#fff2a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='11' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#fff2a8' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='30' r='3' fill='#c98a12'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='30' r='3' fill='#c98a12'/>

  <!-- hammer -->
  <rect x='47' y='16' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='16' r='3.5' fill='#fff2a8'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='26' y='84' width='14' height='8' rx='4' fill='#b8b8d0'/>
  <rect x='60' y='84' width='14' height='8' rx='4' fill='#b8b8d0'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='30' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='30' fill='none' stroke='#ffb87a' stroke-width='2.5'/>

  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='21' fill='#2b1440'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='21' fill='none' stroke='#ffd9a8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- hands -->
  <line x1='50' y1='57' x2='50' y2='43' stroke='#9ef0ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='57' x2='61' y2='60' stroke='#9ef0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='57' r='2.5' fill='#9ef0ff'/>

  <!-- ticks -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#7fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='1.6' fill='#7fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='57' r='1.6' fill='#7fe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='57' r='1.6' fill='#7fe0ff'/>
</svg>
